title: Columbia, MD — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Columbia, MD: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Columbia is a city in MD with a population of 105,000. Planned community between Baltimore and DC with diverse neighborhoods and Merriweather Post. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
